purpose: Convert precommitted evidence-strength and risk-discipline rules into action-eligibility outputs without generating autonomous trading instructions or certain market-direction claims.

action_semantics.BUY: Open a new exposure; requires current_exposure_exists=false.
action_semantics.ADD: Increase an existing exposure; requires current_exposure_exists=true.
action_semantics.HOLD: Maintain an existing exposure; requires current_exposure_exists=true.
action_semantics.REDUCE: Reduce an existing exposure; requires current_exposure_exists=true.
action_semantics.EXIT: Close an existing exposure; requires current_exposure_exists=true.

input_contract.risk_field_semantics: projected_post_action_position_size and projected_post_action_risk_budget_used are the states that would exist after the contemplated action, so BUY/ADD are evaluated against post-action capacity rather than current capacity.

hard_rules.stop_loss_lock: If an existing exposure has stop_loss_breached=true, output EXIT_REQUIRED regardless of evidence strength or override intent unless a predeclared adjustment condition was already satisfied before the breach.
hard_rules.invalidation_lock: If invalidation_triggered=true and exposure exists, output EXIT_REQUIRED. If no exposure exists, BUY is blocked by evidence rather than converted into a fictitious exit.
hard_rules.risk_budget: If projected_post_action_position_size exceeds position_limit or projected_post_action_risk_budget_used exceeds risk_budget_limit, BUY/ADD are blocked by risk.
hard_rules.anti_averaging_down: ADD while is_averaging_down=true requires independent_add_eligibility=true. A lower price by itself is never sufficient.
hard_rules.evidence_floor: BUY/ADD require STRONG or MODERATE evidence. WEAK blocks risk-increasing actions. INSUFFICIENT returns NO_ACTION_INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE unless EXIT_REQUIRED already has priority.
hard_rules.exit_permission: EXIT and REDUCE are never blocked merely because evidence is weak; risk-reducing actions remain eligible unless a higher-priority EXIT_REQUIRED state applies.
hard_rules.override_logging: override_requested never converts a blocked state into ACTION_ELIGIBLE. It is logged separately and must not be relabeled as model-compliant.

non_goals: No automatic loosening of stop-loss or take-profit rules
No conversion of human override into system approval
